cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Everything Is a Contest
cards.instruction: Turn every difference or disagreement into a competition you intend to win.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Potatoes or pizza? We compare cost per serving, not how much you fancy cheese. My potatoes are already paid for.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My voucher makes the pizza free.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then price is a tie. We proceed to quality. I'll plate the potatoes for a blind tasting.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Fine. I'll put the pizza on an identical plate.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Cut it into equal portions first. I will not lose a properly run tasting because you gave the judge more cheese.
